title: Three-value model: Extraction / Claim / Master
source: PRD FR-41 (line 225) and section 8 line 140 (the three-value model: every field keeps Extraction, Claim and Master values; rules run on the Extraction Value only; an edit is flagged, both values kept, a reason required, an edit can never clear a failed rule); RULE-EDIT-01 (md/rules.json) preserves the extraction and stores the correction separately with actor, time, reason and version. PRD line 159 lists Claim Value and edit reason as per-field data.

claim.edited_label_source: PRD section 8 line 140 — the exact neutral wording; never 'corrected', 'overridden' or any word that judges the edit.
claim.confirm_label_source: plain UI copy for a claim that agrees with the extraction (not a PRD phrase).

master_source.note: No master record source is integrated in this prototype, so the Master Record Value stays unknown. md/rules.json defines it as a 'Value from a trusted, authorized master source, if one is actually integrated' — unknown, never guessed, and never filled from the extraction itself.

human_review: Role permissions determine who may accept an edit as a verified value.
note: Outcomes and human_review are md/rules.json's RULE-EDIT-01 vocabulary, copied here and pinned to the spec file by a test so the two cannot drift (same pattern as doc_check_policy.json). These outcomes describe PROVENANCE of an edit — 'continue' means the correction is fully recorded, never that the application passes anything; no rule outcome and no workflow transition reads the Claim Value.
